name: @tavyno/api-client
description: Typed Tavyno REST API client for web and React Native

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
